hook.name: TesseraHook
hook.description: A time-decaying toll hook that charges a fee on the ETH leg of swaps in a designated pool. The fee starts at 25% at pool launch (triggered by a named seeder's first liquidity add) and decays linearly to ~1% over 180 seconds. Tolls accrue as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager and are paid to a fixed mosaic address via a permissionless collect function.
